title: Local Inference Test Bench leaderboard transport index
description: A constant-shape index for deterministic, same-origin leaderboard shards across the logical 1.0 to 1.1 migration.
$comment: index_version remains 1.0 because sharding transport is unchanged. schema_version identifies the logical projected-entry contract used by every referenced shard. The schema encodes the zero/zero and positive/positive branches. Standard JSON Schema cannot compare sibling numeric values, so the Python builder and browser additionally enforce shard_count <= entry_count. Shard paths are never supplied by public data.
